description: This file defines the ResId struct and associated functions for representing and manipulating Kubernetes resource identifiers, including namespace, name, and GVK (Group, Version, Kind). It includes methods for creating, comparing, and serializing resource IDs.

classes.name: ResId
classes.description: Represents a Kubernetes resource identifier with GVK, name, and namespace.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ResId, including GVK, name, and namespace.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string to create a ResId object.

methods.name: FromRNode
methods.description: Creates a ResId from a yaml.RNode object.

methods.name: GvknEquals
methods.description: Checks if another ResId matches in Group, Version, Kind, and name.

methods.name: IsSelectedBy
methods.description: Determines if the ResId is selected by a given selector ResId.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if another ResId matches in namespace, GVK, and name.

methods.name: IsNsEquals
methods.description: Checks if another ResId is in the same effective namespace.

methods.name: IsInDefaultNs
methods.description: Checks if the ResId is in the default namespace or cluster scoped.

methods.name: EffectiveNamespace
methods.description: Returns a non-ambiguous, non-empty namespace for the ResId.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if all fields of the ResId are empty.
